Game Overview

Water Wings puts players into a airplane experience centered on quick, browser-based gameplay.

How to Play

Playing Water Wings comes down to a simple loop. Jump in, follow the on-screen goal, and aim to beat your own best result each run.

Related FAQs

What is Water Wings?

Water Wings is a free airplane game you can play instantly in your browser, with no download required.

Is Water Wings free to play?

Yes, Water Wings is completely free to play in your browser on GameBurst — no download or installation needed.
